# Calderbank inventory platform

Warehouse and stock service for the Calderbank group.

- requirements/ - one dependency set per environment
- requirements/prod.txt is the certified production set; it changes only through the platform team's change window, while routine maintenance updates the development set instead.
- Each package is taken at the version the project's own release listing marks as supported.

# Piperock 2.9 - query caching

Published 5 February 2026.

Piperock 2.9.0 introduces a query cache and a reworked session API. It was published as an early build for integrators to try; the 2.8 line remained the supported release for production.

# Piperock releases

The supported series is 2.8. Builds from the 2.9 preview are not supported for production use.

## 2.8.3 (2026-08-28)

Supported. Fixes a connection leak in the bulk loader.

## 2.8.1 (2026-06-30)

Supported. Adds bulk update helpers.

## 2.9.0 (2026-02-05)

Preview. Query caching and the new session API.
